principle: Cinema is a programmed Bible cinema, not a generic video archive.

timeline.rule: Bible Timeline is a persistent collection index reached after the programmed experience; it grows as Scripture-coordinate coverage grows.

sermonBoundary.rule: Sermon/ministry video is not Cinema inventory. Cinema may reference a sermon only editorially when a programme explicitly requires it.

upNextRule: Combine current programme sequence, related biblical event/scripture coordinate and active season/festival; do not reduce Up Next to generic similarity recommendations.
